err_bad_record: Ignored an invalid index record — rebuild the index
err_index: Failed to index the search folder
err_no_fzf: fzf not found — install fzf to use this plugin
err_spawn: Could not run the search command
index_missing: External disks are only indexed on demand — press ↻ to index this scope

launcher.index_missing: No index for this scope yet

ranking.path: path-aware — a match starting a name wins

root_invalid: Type a plain absolute path, like /media/data (not / and no .. segments)
search_placeholder: Type to search files and folders…

exclude_dirs.description: Folder names skipped while indexing, separated by ',' or ';' (matched anywhere in the tree), e.g. '.git, node_modules, .cache'.
exclude_dirs.label: Excluded folders

max_results.description: How many matches the panel lists at most.
max_results.label: Max results

search_folder.description: Root folder the search indexes. Defaults to your home folder when empty.
search_folder.label: Search folder

show_hidden.description: Index files and folders whose name starts with a dot.
show_hidden.label: Include hidden entries

space_enabled.description: Show the Space tab (disk usage, needs ncdu and jq). Off: search only, nothing is scanned.
space_enabled.label: Space tab

space_skip_external.description: Skip USB and other removable disks in the Space scan. A change starts a new scan.
space_skip_external.label: Space tab: skip external disks

space_skip_network.description: Skip network (NFS, SMB) and FUSE (rclone, sshfs, OneDrive) mounts in the Space scan. A change starts a new scan.
space_skip_network.label: Space tab: skip network and FUSE mounts

usage_exclude_dirs.description: Folders left out of the usage chart and the Space scan, separated by ',' or ';'. A name matches anywhere below the search folder. An absolute or ~ path skips that one folder, e.g. a disk under /mnt.
usage_exclude_dirs.label: Disk usage: excluded folders

space_capped: Showing the {count} biggest files of this type

space_err.datadir: No plugin data folder — cannot store the scan
space_err.empty: ncdu wrote no scan — the folder may be unreadable
space_err.index: The new disk usage index is damaged — press ↻ to scan again
space_err.index_big: The disk index is too big for this plugin — skip more folders in the settings, then scan again
space_err.jq: jq not found — install jq to use this tab
space_err.ncdu: ncdu not found — install ncdu 2.0 or newer to use this tab
space_err.ncdu_old: ncdu is too old — this tab needs ncdu 2.0 or newer
space_err.reduce: jq could not read the ncdu scan
space_err.spawn: Could not start the disk scan
space_err.timeout: The disk scan took too long and was stopped

space_gone: {path} is no longer on disk — press ↻ to scan again
space_rescanning: Scanning again — the numbers below are from the last scan
space_search_outside: That folder is outside the search folder
space_search_unavailable: Search here works only with the search folder scope.
space_tip_top: Back to the top of the home folder
space_unreadable: {count} folders could not be read — the sizes may be too low
tip_disks_on: Include removable (USB) disks in the search

tip_mode.folders: Search the search folder and the folders you add
tip_mode.system:
Search the whole system (/)
Remote, FUSE and removable disks stay excluded

tip_ranking_unsupported: Path-aware ranking needs fzf 0.36 or newer
tip_root_add: Search one more folder next to the search folder
tip_root_add_off: Switch to Home + folders to add search paths
tip_usage_folder_only: The usage chart only measures the search folder
tip_usage_show: Show what fills the search folder
title: File Search
tooltip_closed:
File search — {path}

tooltip_open:
